business_summary: Arealink Co., Ltd. engages in the self-storage business in Japan. The company operates, manages, and rents storage spaces under the Hello Storage brand; and offers land rights development services, asset management, office management, including leasing land and buildings, and other operational services. It rents offices under the Hello Office brand; and provides property management and maintenance services. Arealink Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.
